verdict.rationale: Letta ships a documented Agent SDK for building/resuming agents programmatically, plus a self-hosted App Server exposing an OpenAI-compatible API and ACP adapter for client integration, corroborated by a runtime probe showing the server booting and listening keylessly. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (all candidate URLs 404'd) and independent third-party API-integration reports beyond first-party docs.
